name: Passerines
description: Songbirds as one bundled node - the source's own >50% rule aggregates all passerines into this single node because most diet studies reported only 'passerines'. Functional group pooling the source's Passerines cluster node; no diet links are resolved for it (the basal rule placed it at producer level), and it is leveled here as a primary consumer and a staple prey of raptors, foxes and mink.
